R. s. 12</cite>, end <he>הואיל ולגיון … נותן לו פ׳ שלא תזוז וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="Q01733"><he>פרוקפי</he></cite>) because this legion was the first to proclaim me king, I will give it a preferment (rank) which shall not be taken from it; <he>הרי אני נותן לה פ׳ וכ׳</he> I will give her (the earth) a position from which she shall never be moved (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 104:5">Ps. CIV, 5</cite>); <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 93:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCIII</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 847:1">Yalk. ib. 847</cite> <cite ref="Q01720"><he>פרוסקופי</he></cite> (corr. acc.).

R. s. 48</cite> <he>כל מי שתופשו אני נותן פ׳</he> whoever will seize him (the chief robber), him will I promote; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 48:6">ib.</cite> <he>איזו פ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="Q00444"><he>פָּחַד</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 304">Yalk. <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 90:2">Gen. R. s. 90</cite> [read:] <he>שלא יהא אדם נוטל פ׳ וכ׳</he> that none shall receive preferment except through thee; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 148">Yalk. ib. 148</cite> (not <he>פורק׳</he>).

<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 2:16">Ruth R. to I, 12</cite> <cite ref="Q01725"><he>פרופקפוא</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q01725"><he>פרופקפיא</he></cite> (corr. acc.); a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="Q01733"><he>פְּרוֹקְפָּאוֹת</he></cite>.
